    # Compare repeated 1/3 panels; mark the locations where their patterns differ.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    comps = []

                stack = [(r, c)]
                seen.add((r, c))
                cells = []

                    cells.append((y, x))

                        if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] and (yy,xx) not in seen:

                            stack.append((yy,xx))
                comps.append(cells)

                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and grid[yy][xx] != 0 and (yy,xx) not in seen:

                        stack.append((yy,xx))
